metadata.description: A collection of professional AI skills, agents, commands, and hooks, packaged as Claude and Codex plugins and deployable globally across vendors or per project.

plugins.name: knowledge_management
plugins.description: Skills and agents for building, maintaining, and distilling a persistent, interlinked knowledge base. Ships the wiki, wiki_wrapup, wiki_import, executive_summary, and spr skills, and the wiki_auto_shaper agent.

plugins.name: ai_dev
plugins.description: Skills for everyday AI-assisted development: structured git commits, day-grouped changelog maintenance, writing and formatting AI instructions (prompts, rules, skill files, agent definitions), and language style guides for markdown, Python, and Rust.
